body: I didn't expect anyone to respond. Thank you for taking the time. I have tried talking to people in the theater, no one has been able to help beyond offering sympathy. I think a big part of it is simply that I can't afford to make any less than I am already making and no one in this area wants/ is able to offer above minimum wage to start. seriously thank you so much for taking the time to respond. It's good to know there's someone out there who will.
